extDesc.message: Hands browser downloads to PDM and finds videos on pages.

menuVideo.message: Download this page's video with PDM

popupNotRunning.message: PDM is not running (it starts when a download comes)

popupClosed.message: PDM was closed by you. Downloads stay in the browser until you start PDM again.

popupNotInstalled.message: PDM not found. Install PDM and run it once.

popupSkipNext.message: Let the browser handle the next download

popupSkipNextOn.message: The next download stays in the browser

popupNoMedia.message: No media found yet. Try playing the video.

optExtensions.message: File types to hand over (space separated)

optVideoButton.message: Show the "Download with PDM" button on videos

optSendCookies.message: Send cookies to PDM for downloads that need a login

optNote.message: Tip: to keep one download in the browser, use "Let the browser handle the next download" in the popup. If PDM cannot be reached, the download always continues in the browser.

grabSentPartial.message: $A$ links sent to PDM; $B$ more are still ticked (500 per send): press the button again

popupExtOutdated.message: Extension is outdated (v$A$, PDM has v$B$). Reload PDM on the browser's extensions page; in Firefox use PDM → Settings → Browser → "Add to Firefox".

videoButtonClose.message: Hide for this video (until the page reloads)
